g.text: RAIkeep API-Level Remote CRUURD Test Flow
Please use CSS style instead of skinparam ParticipantPadding
Verify ssh reachability and remote GoogleDrive root
Verify API reachability and scenario endpoint
Create -> Read -> Update -> Update -> Read -> Delete
Create PitItem locally and save JsonPit
Assert create stage ordering and payload
Update item fields and save JsonPit
Update item again and save JsonPit
Assert final updated state and no stale values
Assert delete stage ordering and absence
Pass with full propagation timing report
Disk visibility and API visibility are separate facts.
Disk sync success does not guarantee API freshness.
